variants.label: Ortigia + Taormina · 7 nights · Jun 12–20
variants.notes: Four Ortigia nights and three near Taormina with one automatic rental. Palermo, Agrigento and the west are deliberately out of scope; they belong to a full-length Sicily trip, not this week.

alternateNotes: The week is already the short variant of the documented switzerland-sicily and portugal-sicily Sicily legs; no shorter or cheaper sub-variant is evidence-backed.
